# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Reporting potential vulnerabilities is strongly encouraged.

If you suspect a vulnerability in Exe CRM, contact AskExe support/security through your AskExe support channel or email `security@askexe.com`. Include:

- affected version or image tag,
- deployment mode,
- clear reproduction steps,
- expected vs actual behavior,
- impact assessment, and
- any relevant logs with secrets redacted.

You can expect an initial response within one business day. Please maintain confidentiality until customers have had reasonable time to apply a fix.

Exe CRM is based on Twenty and preserves upstream license attribution, but customer vulnerability intake is handled by AskExe.
